name: qavajs
description: qavajs test automation framework vscode extension

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Running tests executes workspace code, so it is disabled in untrusted workspaces. Launch commands from workspace settings are ignored until the workspace is trusted.

cucumber.features.markdownDescription:
The `cucumber.features` setting overrides where the extension 
should look for `.feature` files. 

If no feature files are found, [autocomplete](#autocomplete) 
will not work.

Default value:

```json 
{
  "cucumber.features": [
    "features/**/*.feature"
  ]
}
```

cucumber.glue.markdownDescription:
The `cucumber.glue` setting overrides where the extension
should look for source code where step definitions and
parameter types are defined.

If no glue files are found, [autocomplete](#autocomplete) 
will not work, and all Gherkin steps will be underlined as 
undefined. [Generate step definition](#generate-step-definition)
will not work either.

Default value:

```json
 {
  "cucumber.glue": [
    "node_modules/@qavajs/**/src/*.ts",
    "step_definition/*.js",
    "step_definition/*.ts"
  ]
}
```

qavajs.launchCommand.markdownDescription:
command to run qavajs tests. 
Default value: "npx qavajs run"
qavajs.launchCommand.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `qavajs.launchProfiles` instead. Still used as the command when `qavajs.launchProfiles` is empty.

command.description: Command used to launch tests for this profile

env.description: Extra environment variables for the test process

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the workspace folder (default: the workspace folder)

tags.description: Cucumber tag expression passed as --tags, e.g. "@smoke and not @wip"
